1301000001.name: Syr's Daily Lunch Box Set
1301000001.description:
[Syr's Daily Lunch Box Set]
Syr's Daily Lunch Box Set is a paid monthly service (renewed automatically)
where you can receive the following for {} a month.
You may try it for free for the first month.

■Rewards
・Receive Skip Ticket x5 and Stamina x100 every day by logging in.
・Receive 11 Draw Ticket x1 and Prism Bond Shard x1 every month.
　11 Draw Ticket: A ticket that allows you to pull an 11 Draw Ticket Gacha.
　Prism Bond Shard: Collect 3 of this item and exchange them for a Prism Bond (Ad.) or Prism Bond (As.).
　※11 Draw Ticket and Prism Bond Shard will not be distributed during the free trial period.
・More Monthly Missions with prizes will be unlocked. By meeting the conditions, you can receive rewards such as Iris (Free) and Fertility Medals.
・You can collect Fertility Medals through Monthly Missions and exchange them for limited outfits.

■Notes
・Syr's Daily Lunch Box Set is a monthly paid service that gets renewed automatically. The service will have a subscription period effective for one month after purchasing.
・The first month after subscribing to the service will be a free trial period, but a monthly fee will be charged via the store in use thereafter, and the subscription period will be renewed automatically.
・If the subscription is not terminated two days before the expiry date, the subscription period will be renewed automatically and a monthly fee will be charged.
　I.e. If the subscription period is until October 31st 06:59, the subscription period will be renewed automatically if the subscription is not terminated by October 29th 06:59.
・Please note that even if you delete the app, the automatic renewal will continue if you do not cancel the subscription.
・Subscription can be terminated anytime.
・Even if you cancel your subscription, you will still receive the benefits until the expiration date.
・Syr's Daily Lunch Box Set is only valid for the app account you are using at the time of subscription.
・Syr's Daily Lunch Box Set trial period can only be used once per Apple ID or Google Play account.
・Violation of the above may result in suspension or deletion of your account.
・We will not be able to cancel the payment for multiple/duplicate subscriptions if you have subscribed Syr's Daily Lunch Box Set multiple times with different Apple ID/Google Play accounts.
・You will not be able to receive duplicate benefits for having more than one subscription of Syr's Daily Lunch Box Set.
・Please note that you will not be able to make any new subscriptions until the expiration date of your account in this application before the transfer.
・Also, if you delete the app and create a new account for this app, Syr's Daily Lunch Box Set will not be carried over.
・Please note that the Monthly Missions will be changed at 11:00(PST) on the last day of every month and the monthly challenge status will be reset. Therefore, the period during which you can receive the reward may be shorter depending on when you join.
・Rewards not received by 11:00(PST) on the last day of each month will be lost, so please receive them within this period.
・11 Draw Ticket is valid for 30 days from the date of receipt.
・Lineup of the 11 Draw Ticket Gacha will be updated once every three months, together with the lineup update of regular ticket gachas.
・Prism Bond Shard is valid for 180 days from the date of receipt.
・To check the expiration date, termination procedure and details of Monthly Missions of Syr's Daily Lunch Box Set, please click on the "Details" button.
・Cannot be refunded.
・If the user is a minor, the consent of a parent or guardian is required to purchase products.
